title: engine-ruleset/v0
description: A ruleset that `capsulectl engine check --ruleset FILE` evaluates on one external-check-input/v0. Its definition_digest is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes of this document, so any change to it, a clause's parameters included, is a new digest. The file is JSON; a repeated member is refused. Members not listed here are refused.

schema.description: The format and its version. A later version is a new value here, never a reinterpretation of this one.

ruleset_id.description: The ruleset's name, version included, reported as the result's ruleset_id. No control character.

clauses.description: One finding per clause, in this order. Clause ids are unique. At most 200, so with no control character in any string (each would print as a 6-byte escape) a result of every clause failing with its longest reason stays under capsulectl's 1 MiB output limit.

id.description: The clause's id within the ruleset: the finding's id. No space or control character.

check.description: The engine check the clause runs, name/version.

disposition.description: What a failing clause does on its own: ask (asks the person's approval) or deny (refuses).

record_type_coverage_params.description: Which declared record kinds appear in the input's history. A kind is the string at kind_field (a dotted path into a history entry); other values are not kinds. An empty registered_kinds declares nothing, so the clause is not applicable.
